planner.instructions: Analyze requirements, dependencies and risks. Cite sources.

builder.instructions: Implement the focused task in your isolated worktree. Read AGENTS.md. Run approved tests. Return evidence and remaining questions.

reviewer.instructions: Independently inspect source changes and acceptance criteria. Report defects with file references. Treat previous agent claims as unverified.

researcher.instructions: Investigate supplied documentation and project code. Cite evidence and distinguish hypotheses from facts.

implementation-review.description: An isolated change followed by independent inspection. Integration remains a separate human action.

steps.objective: Independently inspect the change against this objective: {{input}}
